items.title: طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایت معرفی «باشگاه مشتریان یکپارچه»
items.description:
🔴 طراحی و پیاده‌سازی سایت معرفی باشگاه مشتریان

🔹 عنوان پروژه: طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایت معرفی «باشگاه مشتریان یکپارچه»
شرح کلی پروژه:
این پروژه با هدف ایجاد یک وب‌سایت معرفی محور مبتنی بر وردپرس تعریف شده است تا دید روشنی از «باشگاه مشتریان یکپارچه» و قابلیت‌های آن را در اختیار مخاطبان قرار دهد. وب‌سایت باید ظاهر حرفه‌ای و کاربرپسند داشته و ضمن معرفی پروژه، امکان انتشار مقالات و پاسخ به سؤالات متداول را نیز فراهم کند.
نکته مهم:
انتظار طراحی قالب اختصاصی یا اختراع چرخ از اول رو ندارم، حتی با قالب های آماده و ماژول های آماده بتونید کار رو به بهترین شکل ارایه بدین قابل قبول هست
دامنه فعالیت و مسئولیت فریلنسر:
• طراحی رابط کاربری (UI/UX) و ظاهر وب‌سایت
• پیاده‌سازی کامل سایت بر بستر WordPress از صفر تا استقرار نهایی
• ساختاردهی منوها و صفحات اصلی با تمرکز روی معرفی پروژه
• راه‌اندازی بخش وبلاگ (مگ) برای انتشار مطالب مرتبط
• ایجاد بخش سؤالات متداول (FAQ)
• توسعه هر بخش تکمیلی موردنیاز بر اساس فرآیند طراحی و تعامل با کارفرما
ویژگی‌ها و قابلیت‌های اصلی:
• صفحه اصلی با معرفی خلاصه و جذاب از «باشگاه مشتریان یکپارچه»
• بخش مگ (وبلاگ) برای انتشار اخبار و مقالات مرتبط
• صفحه سؤالات متداول با امکان دسته‌بندی و جستجو
• صفحات جزئیات بیشتر برای معرفی امکانات، مزایا و نحوه ثبت‌نام
• طراحی ریسپانسیو و تطبیق‌پذیر با موبایل و تبلت
• سرعت بارگذاری بهینه و استانداردهای SEO پایه
وضعیت فعلی و خروجی مورد انتظار:
• پروژه در مرحله آغازین است.
• خروجی نهایی: یک وب‌سایت معرفی مبتنی بر وردپرس با تمامی بخش‌های فوق آماده و مستقر در هاست کارفرما.
موارد موردنیاز در پروپوزال پیشنهادی:
1. نمونه‌کارهای مرتبط با طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایت‌های معرفی
2. توضیح مختصر از رویکرد و متدولوژی پیشنهادی برای طراحی ساختار صفحات
3. برآورد زمان‌بندی و هزینه پروژه
4. فهرست پیش‌نیازها و اطلاعات (محتوا، تصاویر، دسترسی‌ها) که برای شروع کار از کارفرما نیاز است
مهارت‌ها و تجربیات مورد انتظار:
• تسلط بر وردپرس و قالب‌نویسی (PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• تجربه طراحی UI/UX و کار با افزونه‌های ضروری وردپرس
• آشنایی با اصول بهینه‌سازی سرعت و SEO پایه
• توانایی ارتباط مؤثر و دریافت بازخورد در فرایند طراحی
محل پروژه: به صورت دورکاری
زمان‌بندی پیشنهادی: قابل مذاکره، اما ترجیحاً شروع فوری و تحویل اولیه در بازه ۲–۳ هفته‌ای
فرایند انتخاب فریلنسر:
– بررسی پروپوزال‌ها و نمونه‌کارها
– گفت‌وگوی آنلاین برای بررسی جزئیات
– عقد قرارداد و آغاز مراحل طراحی
لطفاً پیشنهاد خود را بر اساس موارد فوق ارسال نمایید. منتظر همکاری مستمر و حرفه‌ای شما هستیم.

🔴 سئوی مستمر سه وب‌سایت صنعتی و شرکتی

🔹 شرح کلی پروژه:
مدیریت و اجرای مستمر سئو برای سه وب‌سایت موجود متعلق به گروه صنعتی MDP؛ شامل وب‌سایت تجهیزات مخابراتی، انتقال نیرو و سازه‌های پست برق، وب‌سایت سازه‌های فولادی صنعتی، سوله و ساختمان‌های مدولار، و وب‌سایت شرکتی گروه.
هدف پروژه:
تقویت حضور در جست‌وجوی ارگانیک در بازارهای داخلی و بین‌المللی، جذب مشتریان صنعتی واقعی، دریافت استعلام‌های تجاری (RFQ) و توسعه بازارهای صادراتی.
محدوده کار و مسئولیت فریلنسر:
• بررسی و عارضه‌یابی فنی و محتوایی هر سه وب‌سایت و تدوین استراتژی سئو متناسب با بازار و مخاطبان هر برند
• تحقیق کلمات کلیدی تخصصی صنعتی به زبان فارسی و انگلیسی
• اجرای بهینه‌سازی‌های فنی شامل سرعت، ایندکس و ساختار صفحات
• بهینه‌سازی محتوای صفحات محصولات، خدمات و مقالات تخصصی؛ تولید یا آماده‌سازی محتوای موردنیاز به‌صورت مشارکتی
• بهینه‌سازی سئوی داخلی و چندزبانه و اجرای لینک‌سازی داخلی و خارجی با هدف افزایش اعتبار دامنه
• راه‌اندازی و مدیریت Google Search Console و GA4
• پشتیبانی و رسیدگی مستمر به فعالیت‌های سئو و ارائه گزارش ماهانه
نیازمندی‌ها و قابلیت‌های اصلی:
تسلط عملی به Technical SEO، On-Page SEO، Google Search Console، GA4 و سئوی انگلیسی ضروری است. تجربه قابل ارائه در وب‌سایت‌های صنعتی، صادراتی یا B2B مزیت مهمی محسوب می‌شود.
تحویل‌دادنی‌ها و شرایط همکاری:
خروجی اصلی شامل اجرای اقدامات توافق‌شده سئو و گزارش ماهانه از رتبه کلمات کلیدی، ترافیک ارگانیک و سرنخ‌های تجاری است. همکاری به‌صورت دورکاری و با قرارداد اولیه سه‌ماهه، با امکان تمدید بلندمدت، انجام می‌شود. پرداخت مرحله‌ای بر اساس خدمات و خروجی‌های توافق‌شده خواهد بود.
موارد پیشنهادی برای بررسی در پروپوزال:

You’ll collaborate with senior team members while taking ownership of key workstreams and contributing directly to performance outcomes.

Assist in building quarterly roadmaps and prioritising activity
Carry out SEO audits (technical, content, off-page, and GEO)
Identify and implement improvements across site structure, indexing, and performance
Monitor rankings, traffic, and performance metrics, providing regular reporting
Use insights to inform ongoing optimisation
Support client communication through reporting and performance updates
Contribute to meetings and help translate data into clear insights
Work closely with strategists and wider digital teams to deliver integrated outcomes
Stay up to date with developments in SEO and AI-led search
Support the implementation of Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) approaches
Contribute to improving internal processes and ways of working

You'll Ideally Have

~2–4 years’ experience in SEO, ideally agency-side
Solid understanding of technical, on-page, and off-page SEO
Experience using tools such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and draw insights
Confidence managing multiple tasks and deadlines
Clear communication skills—able to explain SEO concepts to different audiences
A proactive approach and willingness to learn and develop

In Return We’ll Give You

A commitment to develop you and your career aspirations.
A no blame culture.
A focus on diversity & inclusion, sustainability, and mental wellbeing.
Stunning office in the heart of Barangaroo close to the restaurants, bars, and the harbour swimming spot
A hybrid working model.
A fully stocked beer and wine fridge, impromptu BBQ lunches, sporting comps, team social activities, and a cracking end of year party.
Enviable benefits such as
Remote working; work from another time zone for up to 8 weeks per year
Birthday leave
A wellbeing day each year

Jaywing are committed to building an inclusive and diverse culture, so if you’re doubting whether to apply for this role because you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to still do so, there may be other opportunities with us where you are in fact the perfect candidate . Please let us know if any adjustments need to be made throughout the interview process and we will do our best to accommodate.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
items.description:
About 8020
8020 is a brand-led digital marketing agency built on four pillars: strategy, creativity, data analytics and technology .
We help brands start meaningful conversations, deliver better customer experiences, build immersive digital journeys and drive measurable ROI. Our services span Insights, Planning & Strategy, UX & UI, Content Development, SEO & GEO, Lead Generation, ORM, Digital Films, CRM, Media Planning and eCommerce Solutions.
We have partnered with brands including Avis, Hathway, Abbott, Wolters Kluwer, Amplus Solar, Apollo Hospitals, Vikram Solar, Airtel, Tata Motors, DS Group, CII and Zuju, from our offices in Gurugram and Sydney.
If you want to make a difference and change the game, 8020 is the place to be.
www.eightytwenty.co.in
The Role
Search has changed. Customers now find brands through Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot as much as through the traditional ten blue links. We are looking for an SEO & Analytics Specialist who understands both worlds: someone with solid technical SEO fundamentals who is also building expertise in Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and uses AI tools intelligently to work faster and smarter.

Key Responsibilities
Search & GEO Strategy
• Build integrated SEO and GEO strategies that improve visibility across traditional search results and AI-generated answers.
• Optimise content for AI citation and answer inclusion: clear question-led structure, concise answer blocks, FAQs, comparison content and verifiable facts.
• Strengthen brand entity signals through structured data, consistent brand information across the web, Knowledge Panel optimisation and E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trust).
• Track and report brand visibility, mentions and citations across AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode) alongside traditional rankings.
• Stay current with Google algorithm and core updates, AI search developments and emerging standards in AI discoverability.
Technical SEO
• Conduct in-depth technical audits covering crawling and indexing (robots.txt, XML sitemaps), canonicalisation, duplicate content, redirects, URL structure, internal linking and site architecture.
• Improve Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), mobile usability and page performance in partnership with development teams.
• Implement and validate schema markup (Organization, Product, FAQ, Article, LocalBusiness, etc.).
• Ensure sites are accessible to both search engine crawlers and AI crawlers, including JavaScript rendering checks.
• Support eCommerce SEO: category and product page optimisation, faceted navigation, product feeds and structured data.

Key Responsibilities
1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.

2. Content SEO & Organic Growth

Identify keyword opportunities relevant to our services and client industries.

Optimise existing service pages, landing pages, blogs, and other website content.

Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve topical authority.

Work with writers and marketing teams to produce useful, search-focused content.

Track content performance and recommend improvements based on data.

3. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Understand how people search for answers through search engines and AI-powered tools.

Research frequently asked questions and identify opportunities for answer-focused content.

Structure website content with clear headings, direct answers, and useful explanations.

Optimise relevant pages to improve their eligibility for featured snippets and other answer-oriented search experiences.

Use structured data where appropriate and ensure website information is accurate and consistent.

4. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search Visibility
Develop an understanding of how brands and websites appear in AI-generated search results and answers.

Monitor brand mentions and citations across platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI search experiences.

Identify relevant queries for which Fortheye and client brands should be discoverable.

Analyse competitor visibility and identify opportunities to improve brand discoverability.

Help improve content clarity, factual accuracy, topical relevance, and credibility.

Research opportunities to earn genuine brand mentions and references from relevant, reputable websites.

Track observable changes in AI citations, linked sources, brand mentions, and referral traffic where available.

We don’t expect you to be a GEO expert already. However, you should understand the fundamentals, be willing to experiment, and be able to explain how you would measure progress.

5. Analytics & Reporting
Monitor organic clicks, impressions, keyword rankings, traffic, and conversions.

Track the performance of priority landing pages and content.

Prepare monthly SEO performance reports with actionable recommendations.

Identify technical and content-related issues affecting website performance.

Maintain an organised record of completed tasks, findings, and next steps.

6. Client Website Management
Assist with SEO audits and optimisation for client websites.

Research keywords and competitors across different industries.

Implement agreed SEO strategies and track performance.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams when required.

Help prepare client reports and communicate progress clearly.

Skills & Qualifications
1–2 years of practical experience in SEO, preferably working on live websites.

A portfolio demonstrating previous SEO projects and measurable outcomes.

Good understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, and search intent.

Hands-on experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent alternatives.

Basic understanding of schema markup, structured data, indexing, and website architecture.

Understanding of content optimisation and SEO-focused content planning.

Familiarity with AEO, GEO, and AI-powered search visibility.

Analytical thinking and the ability to interpret website performance data.

Good written communication and documentation skills.

Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and collaborate with developers and content teams.

Applicants must share at least two relevant websites or SEO projects they have worked on.

Work completed: The optimisations, content improvements, or other changes you implemented.

Improving the technical health and search visibility of Fortheye’s website.

Identifying valuable organic keyword opportunities.

Improving the performance of priority service pages and content.

Growing relevant organic traffic and qualified enquiries over time.

Establishing a practical process for monitoring AI search visibility.

We value sustainable growth, useful content, and measurable business outcomes over vanity metrics or shortcuts.

Hands-on exposure to SEO, AEO, and emerging AI search practices.

Collaboration with product, engineering, design, and marketing teams.

Opportunities to develop practical expertise in organic growth.

• بررسی وضعیت موجود سایت و تعیین اقدامات اجرایی موردنیاز در چارچوب سئو
وضعیت فعلی و مرز مسئولیت:
سایت از قبل راه‌اندازی شده و با WordPress ساخته شده است؛ بنابراین موضوع پروژه، بهبود و بهینه‌سازی سایت موجود است، نه ایجاد یک سایت جدید. تولید محتوای سایت بر عهده کارفرماست و در مسئولیت فریلنسر قرار ندارد. با این حال، فریلنسر مسئول اجرای سایر اقدامات مرتبط با ارتقای سئو است و هر بخش اجرایی موردنیاز باید در پیشنهاد و برآورد او به‌طور شفاف توضیح داده شود.

items.title: بازطراحی حرفه‌ای UI/UX صرافی ارز دیجیتال، رفع باگ‌ها و طراحی
items.description:
🔴 بازطراحی حرفه‌ای UI/UX صرافی ارز دیجیتال، رفع باگ‌ها و طراحی

🔹 برای وب‌سایت صرافی ارز دیجیتال خود به یک توسعه‌دهنده یا تیم باتجربه نیاز دارم تا قالب و رابط کاربری فعلی را به‌صورت اصولی بررسی و بازطراحی کند. وب‌سایت در حال حاضر راه‌اندازی شده و اسکریپت اصلی آن آماده است؛ بنابراین هدف، ساخت یک پروژه از صفر نیست، بلکه بهبود جدی ظاهر، تجربه کاربری، کیفیت فنی و قابلیت توسعه پلتفرم موجود است.
. بازطراحی قالب و رابط کاربری صرافی
ظاهر فعلی نیاز به بازنگری دارد و می‌خواهم رابط صرافی حرفه‌ای‌تر، منسجم‌تر و باکیفیت‌تر شود. انتظار دارم پیش از اعمال تغییرات، صفحات و ساختار فعلی بررسی شوند و سپس طراحی جدید با درنظرگرفتن نیازهای کاربران یک پلتفرم معاملاتی ارائه شود.
موارد مورد انتظار:
طراحی ظاهری حرفه‌ای، مدرن و مناسب یک پلتفرم مالی
ایجاد هویت بصری منسجم برای رنگ‌ها، فونت‌ها، آیکون‌ها، دکمه‌ها و اجزای رابط
بازطراحی چیدمان صفحات و پنل‌های مختلف صرافی
بهبود خوانایی اطلاعات، سلسله‌مراتب بصری و کنتراست
بهبود تجربه کاربری در نسخه دسکتاپ و موبایل
واکنش‌گرا بودن صفحات در اندازه‌های مختلف نمایشگر
رفع شلوغی، فضاهای خالی نامناسب و ناهماهنگی‌های بصری
طراحی مناسب حالت‌های خالی، خطا، بارگذاری و پیام‌های موفقیت
حفظ عملکردهای فعلی سامانه، مگر در مواردی که برای اصلاح یا بهبود، تغییر آن‌ها با توافق لازم باشد
بازطراحی نباید صرفاً به تغییر رنگ‌ها یا چند جزئیات ظاهری محدود شود؛ انتظار دارم نتیجه نهایی از نظر چیدمان، انسجام و کیفیت اجرا تفاوت محسوسی با قالب فعلی داشته باشد.
۲. بررسی و رفع باگ‌های موجود
در حال حاضر چند ایراد و باگ جزئی در سایت وجود دارد که لازم است پس از بررسی، شناسایی و برطرف شوند. پیش از شروع، موارد قابل‌رفع و روش انجام کار مشخص شود و اصلاحات بدون ایجاد اختلال در قابلیت‌های اصلی سایت انجام گیرد.
۳. اصلاح مسیر و دسترسی صفحه مدیریت
آدرس صفحه ادمین باید بررسی و اصلاح شود تا مسیر مدیریت به‌درستی کار کند و دسترسی مدیران سایت بدون مشکل انجام شود. این کار باید با رعایت اصول امنیتی و بدون ایجاد اختلال در ورود کاربران یا سایر بخش‌های سامانه انجام شود.
۴. طراحی لندینگ‌پیج با وردپرس
نیاز دارم با استفاده از WordPress یک لندینگ‌پیج حرفه‌ای برای معرفی صرافی طراحی شود. صفحه باید با هویت بصری سامانه هماهنگ باشد و برای معرفی خدمات و هدایت کاربران به ثبت‌نام یا استفاده از پلتفرم طراحی شود.
انتظار می‌رود لندینگ‌پیج:
ظاهر حرفه‌ای و متناسب با برند داشته باشد؛
در موبایل و دسکتاپ به‌درستی نمایش داده شود؛
امکان ویرایش محتوای معمول را از طریق وردپرس فراهم کند؛
از نظر سرعت، ساختار و اصول پایه سئو مناسب باشد؛
به سایت یا بخش ثبت‌نام صرافی به‌درستی لینک شود.
۵. آمادگی برای توسعه‌های بعدی
ممکن است در مراحل بعدی، قابلیت‌ها و امکانات جدیدی به وب‌سایت اضافه شود. بنابراین همکاری با فردی مدنظر است که بتواند ساختار فعلی پروژه را بشناسد، تغییرات را با احتیاط و مستند انجام دهد و برای توسعه‌های آینده نیز قابل‌دسترس باشد. جزئیات قابلیت‌های احتمالی آینده در صورت توافق، جداگانه تعریف و برآورد خواهند شد.

Company Description Cantrell Schuette is a Tampa-based law firm dedicated to correcting injustice. Our niches inclide protecting franchisee rights, employee rights, and personal injury. The firm offers a supportive environment for legal and non-legal professionals who want to contribute to meaningful, impact-driven work.

Role Description The Senior SEO Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in Tampa, FL. This role is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive SEO strategies to increase organic visibility, qualified traffic, and lead generation for the firm’s practice areas.

Day-to-day responsibilities include performing keyword research, optimizing on-page content and metadata, managing technical SEO initiatives, and improving site architecture and internal linking. The Senior SEO Specialist will monitor rankings and performance metrics, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights for leadership and marketing teams. The role also involves collaborating on content planning, coordinating with external vendors when needed, and staying current with search engine algorithm updates and best practices in legal industry SEO. Preference for experience eith digital ads too, including Google, Facebook, Instagram, and AI.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong skills in keyword research, on-page optimization, and content optimization.
Candidates should possess skills in technical SEO, including site audits, crawl and index management, page speed optimization, and structured data implementation.
Candidates should possess skills in analytics and reporting, including use of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz).
Candidates should possess skills in link-building strategy, competitive analysis, and organic traffic growth initiatives.
Candidates should possess skills in cross-functional collaboration, communicating SEO recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and aligning SEO with broader marketing goals.
Relevant experience in SEO within professional services, legal, or similar regulated industries is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and thrive in a hybrid work environment is expected.

🔹 شرح کلی پروژه:
همکاری برای انجام امور عملیاتی و پشتیبانی یک سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی موجود. حوزه همکاری شامل ثبت محصول، پشتیبانی سایت، انجام تمامی امور سئو و طراحی گرافیک موردنیاز سایت، به‌ویژه بنر و اسلایدر است.
محدوده کار و مسئولیت فریلنسر:
• ثبت و به‌روزرسانی محصولات در سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی

وضعیت فعلی و بستر پروژه:
سایت فروشگاهی وردپرسی موجود است و همکاری بر پایه رسیدگی و بهبود همین سایت انجام می‌شود، نه ایجاد یک سایت جدید. جزئیات حجم ثبت محصولات، نوع درخواست‌های پشتیبانی و محدوده هر فعالیت سئو می‌تواند با توجه به نیازهای جاری سایت در زمان همکاری مشخص شود.

همکاری می‌تواند به‌صورت ساعتی، دائمی یا پروژه‌ای انجام شود. جزئیات شیوه همکاری، حجم کار و برآورد هزینه لازم است در پیشنهاد فریلنسر مشخص شود.

ابتدا باهم 3 ماه کار میکنیم، درصورت رضایت دوطرفه در یک پروژه جدید باهم ادامه خواهیم داد.

items.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior SEO & AEO Specialist (B2B Tech / Agency)

Location:  Bangalore

Type:  Full-time

Experience:  3-8 years in SEO/AEO (B2B Tech / SaaS experience required; Agency experience preferred)

About The Role

We are looking for an analytical, modern, and outcome-oriented Senior SEO & AEO Specialist to manage organic growth strategies across a portfolio of B2B technology clients.

In this agency role, you won't just run traditional SEO campaigns-you will bridge technical SEO, high-intent keyword strategies, and cutting-edge Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

You must be a natural problem-solver who uses AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive execution, free up strategic bandwidth, and deliver clear pipeline results for multi-client accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Keyword & Entity Strategy (SEO + AEO)

High-Intent B2B Keyword Mapping: Uncover non-branded, high-intent BOFU (Bottom-of-Funnel) keywords, intent clusters, and buyer queries that drive pipeline rather than just vanity traffic.

AEO & LLM Optimization: Identify entity relationships, brand citations, and prompt queries used across AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot).

Search Intent & Gap Analysis: Run competitive content gap analyses to map buyer journeys across traditional search SERPs and AI response outputs.

On-Page & Content Optimization

AEO Content Engineering: Structure and optimize client content for direct retrieval by LLMs-focusing on concise answer blocks, clear headers, schema alignment, and authoritative citations.

On-Page Execution: Optimize meta tags, heading hierarchies, internal linking structures, CTA placements, and content freshups across client web properties.

AI-Assisted Content Briefs: Produce detailed, data-backed content briefs using AI workflows to scale quality output for client writing teams.

Technical SEO & Site Architecture

Comprehensive Audits: Perform deep-dive technical audits across complex B2B sites.

Technical Fixes: Resolve issues related to crawlability, indexability, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, page speed, canonicalization, and XML sitemaps.

Schema & Structured Data: Implement advanced schema markup (Organization, Product, Article, FAQ, TechArticle) to strengthen site entities for both search engines and LLM indexers.

Off-Page & Brand Authority

Digital PR & Citation Strategy: Build brand authority and digital footprint through high-quality B2B backlink profiles, unlinked mention reclamation, and strategic guest placements.

LLM Visibility Building: Drive inclusion in trusted third-party review sites (G2, Capterra, Gartner), tech publications, and industry directories that modern LLMs use as grounding data.

AI-Powered Automation & Workflow Scaling

Task Automation: Leverage custom GPTs, APIs, or automation platforms (Make, Zapier, Python scripts) to automate repetitive tasks like meta creation, internal link mapping, technical monitoring, and keyword clustering.

Workflow Optimization: Use AI tools to accelerate strategy creation and analysis without sacrificing quality or accuracy.

Analytics, Client Reporting & Growth Ownership

Multi-Client Portfolio Management: Simultaneously balance campaign strategy, technical execution, and project timelines across 4–6 B2B tech accounts.

Data & Attribution Modeling: Analyze performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and BI tools (Looker Studio) to track traffic, conversions, MQLs, and SQLs.

Client Presentations & Communication: Translate complex technical data into clear business narratives. Lead monthly/quarterly strategy calls with CMOs, VP of Marketing, and demand gen leaders.

Problem Solving & Result Delivery: Proactively identify drop-offs or algorithm impact, pivot strategies rapidly, and take personal accountability for achieving quarterly KPIs (pipeline growth, keyword ownership, AI share of voice).

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 3 to 8 years of hands-on SEO/AEO experience, with a heavy emphasis on B2B Tech or SaaS brands.

Agency Experience: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize tasks under deadlines, and pivot strategies based on client goals.
AEO & Generative Search Expertise: Solid understand of vector search, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), entity graphs, and how modern AI tools retrieve and synthesise content.
AI & Automation Proficiency: Practical, hands-on experience using AI software and automation scripts to handle heavy-lifting operational tasks.
Client-Facing Skills: Strong verbal and written communication. Comfortable presenting data, answering tough questions on calls, and advising client marketing leads.
Tool Stack Mastery: Advanced experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, and Looker Studio.

Benefits

Competitive compensation based on capability
Salary credited on last day of the month – Always
Company paid health insurance for you and your family
Exposure to global B2B technology clients
Opportunity to work with modern marketing and AI tools
Collaborative team culture
5-day On-site work week

At AEK Media, we believe your marketing approach should revolve around your customer journey.

As a fast- growing company, AEK Media offers you the chance to shape your career as we expand together. This growth also brings the challenge of navigating a dynamic, fast-paced environment, where your ability to adapt and innovate will be essential. ⚡

🔍 No Black Boxes

💼 Consider The Commercial

items.title: SEO/GEO specialist (junior)

Al sinds 2012 hét online marketing bureau uit het Westland. Ons doel is om bedrijven (online) te helpen groeien met behulp van online marketing. Je stelt strategieën op om de vindbaarheid in (AI-gestuurde) zoekmachines te verbeteren.

Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid af en toe thuis te werken.
Gezellige collega’s (al zeggen we het zelf) die houden van een borrel, potje darten en vooral gezelligheid.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
items.description:
Blinto is looking for a data-driven and execution-focused SEO Strategist who can take ownership of organic growth from strategy to implementation and reporting.

This role is for someone who can look beyond rankings and understand how technical SEO, content, search intent, authority, user experience, and conversion work together to create sustainable organic growth.

You will work across Blinto and client websites, identifying SEO opportunities, building clear roadmaps, working with content and development teams, and measuring whether the work is actually producing results.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable digging into data, identifying the real reason behind performance changes, prioritizing what matters most, and turning SEO insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct comprehensive SEO audits across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content, internal linking, indexing, and backlink health, then turn findings into prioritized action plans.
Perform keyword, competitor, and search-intent research to identify opportunities that can generate relevant organic traffic, leads, and business growth.
Lead on-page and content optimization, including metadata, heading structure, internal linking, content quality, topical relevance, and E-E-A-T considerations.
Work closely with developers on technical SEO improvements such as Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, schema, redirects, site architecture, and website performance.
Monitor rankings, traffic, conversions, backlinks, and search visibility, then prepare clear monthly reports with insights, priorities, and recommended next actions.

Who We Are Looking For:

You may be a strong fit if you:
Have 2–3 years of hands-on SEO experience in an agency, in-house team, or similar professional environment.
Can independently investigate SEO problems instead of relying only on automated audit scores or tool recommendations.
Understand the connection between search intent, content quality, technical SEO, authority, and conversion.
Are comfortable working with developers, writers, designers, and growth teams to move SEO initiatives forward.
Take ownership of results, communicate clearly, and are willing to test, learn, and continuously improve your approach.

Experience & Knowledge:

Strong practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, content optimization, internal linking, and backlink analysis .
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio .
Good understanding of Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, redirects, schema markup, canonicalization, and website architecture .
Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS , with the ability to communicate technical SEO requirements clearly to developers.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to connect SEO performance to traffic, leads, conversions, and business objectives.
Experience with Local SEO, Google Business Profile, GTM, digital PR, SQL, Python for SEO, or SEO automation will be considered an advantage.

What We Value:

At Blinto, we look for SEO professionals who:
Focus on measurable growth rather than rankings alone.
Use data to understand problems before recommending solutions.
Prioritize work based on potential impact instead of trying to fix everything at once.
Can explain SEO clearly to both technical and non-technical team members.
Take ownership of recommendations and follow them through to implementation.
Keep learning as search, AI, algorithms, and user behavior continue to evolve.
Want to grow with Blinto and contribute to building a stronger organic growth capability over the long term.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and capability.
Yearly salary review and increment based on performance.
Festival bonuses.
Subsidized breakfast and lunch.
Transportation allowance.
Paid time off.
Yearly best performer recognition and bonus.
A supportive environment focused on learning, ownership, and professional growth.
Opportunity to work across different industries, websites, and real business growth challenges.

Ready To Apply?

If you enjoy turning SEO data into clear strategies, solving technical and content problems, and building organic growth that contributes to real business outcomes, we would like to hear from you.
Please apply with your CV and, where possible, examples or case studies of SEO projects you have worked on.
Blinto evaluates candidates based on SEO knowledge, analytical ability, problem-solving, execution skills, ownership, communication, and suitability for the role .

At Fonroche Lighting America, we are transforming the way outdoor spaces are illuminated with off-grid, solar-powered street lighting. Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SEO Specialist to join our Marketing Team and lead the continued growth of our organic search presence. This role will focus on technical SEO, keyword strategy, content optimization, search intent, analytics, and organic performance.

Working alongside the Marketing Team, you will develop and execute SEO strategies that increase our visibility across traditional search engines while ensuring our website provides valuable, authoritative information to prospective customers. You will work across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, competitor research, and performance analytics to improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and conversions.

As search continues to evolve, you will also stay informed on emerging AI-powered search experiences and incorporate relevant best practices into our broader organic search strategy.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Organic Growth

Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with company marketing and business goals.
Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent analysis, SERP analysis, and content-gap research.
Identify opportunities to increase organic visibility for high-value commercial, municipal, industry, and product-related searches.
Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and overall search performance.
Develop strategies to improve rankings, qualified traffic, engagement, and lead generation.
Research emerging search trends and adjust SEO strategies accordingly.

Technical SEO

Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.
Monitor and improve site architecture, crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, redirects, internal linking, and URL structure.
Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability, and overall website performance.
Identify and troubleshoot technical issues affecting organic visibility.
Implement and maintain structured data and Schema.org markup.
Work with development and website resources to prioritize and resolve technical SEO issues.
Support SEO requirements for website redesigns, migrations, new pages, and other website initiatives.

On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize existing website pages to improve rankings, relevance, and user experience.
Develop SEO recommendations for landing pages, product pages, case studies, FAQs, blog articles, project pages, and educational resources.
Create SEO-focused content briefs based on keyword research, customer questions, search intent, and competitive analysis.
Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal links, image attributes, URLs, and on-page content.
Develop and maintain topic clusters to strengthen topical authority.
Identify opportunities to improve existing content based on search performance and changing search intent.
Ensure content is optimized for both search engines and human readers.

Link Building & Authority

Identify opportunities to strengthen website authority through high-quality backlinks, industry mentions, partnerships, and digital PR.
Monitor backlink profiles and identify potentially harmful or low-quality links.
Research competitor backlink strategies and identify relevant opportunities.
Support strategies that increase the company's authority and visibility within relevant industries.

Analytics & Reporting

Establish and monitor SEO KPIs and performance benchmarks.
Track organic rankings, traffic, conversions, engagement, backlinks, and technical SEO health.
Use Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other SEO tools to analyze performance.
Identify trends and opportunities within organic search data.
Prepare regular SEO performance reports and communicate actionable insights to the Marketing Director and other stakeholders.
Connect organic search performance to qualified leads and broader marketing objectives.

AI & Emerging Search

Stay current with developments in AI-powered search and evolving search engine features.
Monitor how AI-generated search experiences may affect organic search behavior and website visibility.
Identify opportunities to structure and optimize content so it can be effectively understood and surfaced by emerging search technologies.
Incorporate relevant AI search, semantic search, and entity optimization practices into the overall SEO strategy as the industry evolves.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in B2B, technology, infrastructure, manufacturing, construction, SaaS, or other complex sales environments.
Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, search intent, and content optimization.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing SEO strategies.
Experience conducting technical SEO audits and identifying website optimization opportunities.
Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
Working knowledge of structured data and Schema.org.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple SEO initiatives and prioritize opportunities based on business impact.
Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and adapt as search engines and SEO best practices evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

WordPress experience; Avada experience is a plus.
Experience with enterprise or B2B SEO.
Experience with local and geographic SEO.
Experience with technical SEO for large or complex websites.
Experience with content strategy and topic-cluster development.
Experience with link-building, digital PR, and authority-building strategies.
Knowledge of entity SEO and semantic search.
Familiarity with AI-powered search platforms and emerging search technologies.
Experience in municipal, government, infrastructure, engineering, construction, energy, sustainability, or architectural markets is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, the successful candidate will help our company:

Increase qualified organic visibility and rankings for high-value commercial and municipal searches.
Increase qualified organic traffic and conversions.
Improve the technical health, crawlability, and overall SEO performance of the website.
Build stronger topical authority around customer needs, applications, technologies, products, and markets.
Identify and capitalize on new keyword and content opportunities.
Develop a consistent, data-driven SEO reporting and optimization process.
Improve the company's authority and visibility within relevant search results.
Establish a scalable SEO strategy that supports continued organic growth.

The Candidate We’re Looking For

We're looking for an SEO professional who is equally comfortable digging into technical website issues, analyzing search data, researching competitors, and identifying content opportunities.

You should be able to look at a website and determine not only what is preventing it from ranking, but also what opportunities exist to improve its visibility and attract the right customers. We're looking for someone who is analytical, curious, proactive, and excited about building a strong organic search presence for a growing company.
